FIELDS.NAME: Horizon Realty Group
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Horizon Realty Group specializes in residential property sales, acting as an intermediary in property transactions. Our core operations include client engagement for property listings, conducting market analysis, and facilitating negotiations between buyers and sellers. We pride ourselves on maintaining a robust compliance program that addresses fair housing, anti-discrimination laws, and licensing requirements to ensure all transactions are handled ethically and legally. Our team consists of experienced and licensed agents who leverage advanced technology for transaction management and client communication, enhancing efficiency and security. We prioritize comprehensive disclosures and documentation practices to minimize risks of misrepresentation, contributing to a clean claims history and proactive risk management.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a minor water damage incident occurred in one of the residential properties associated with Horizon Realty Group due to a plumbing issue, resulting in repair costs amounting to $2,000. The claim has been closed, and the repairs have been successfully completed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the property with regular patrols conducted by watchpersons to ensure safety and deter unauthorized access.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Horizon Realty Group has not engaged in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in any past or present operations. Our focus remains on residential property sales and we maintain strict compliance with relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Horizon Realty Group does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its operations. The focus remains strictly on residential property transactions and related activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our compliance team to ensure all necessary coverage requirements are met.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Horizon Realty Group has not had any applicant indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We uphold a high standard of ethics in our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Horizon Realty Group has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years, maintaining a clean insurance history.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Horizon Realty Group does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our operations focus exclusively on residential property transactions. All staff members are directly employed by our agency.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Horizon Realty Group carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees in the event of work-related injuries or illnesses.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Horizon Realty Group owns another business, Horizon Property Management Services, which focuses on managing residential properties. This operation complements our core real estate services by providing property management solutions for our clients.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Horizon Realty Group currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Our insurance needs are fully covered by the existing policy with policy number HRG-2024-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Horizon Realty Group is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on residential property sales and related services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Horizon Realty Group does not rent or loan equipment to others as our primary operations focus on residential property sales and related activities. We maintain compliance with industry standards and prioritize risk management.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Horizon Realty Group has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial profile.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Horizon Realty Group does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus exclusively on residential property sales and related activities, in strict compliance with safety regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Horizon Realty Group does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations focus exclusively on residential property sales and do not involve activities that could result in significant catastrophic risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Horizon Realty Group has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize compliance and ethical conduct in all transactions.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Horizon Realty Group has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all safety regulations.
